notes: Confirmed default release policy: publish three consecutive chapters as one group at exactly 00:00 Asia/Shanghai each day. All three chapters in a group intentionally share the same 00:00 timestamp. When the author explicitly approves additional releases, extend the queue in consecutive three-chapter groups; do not split a group into 1-2 extra chapters or skip chapter order. Repository sync remains separately gated by config.json sync_enabled and explicit audited queue authorization.
